name: Lumen
description: Plays files as they are: the browser remuxes them and decodes the audio, the server only sends bytes.
overview: Playback without server-side transcoding for the web client.

versions.changelog: The playback log tells apart, in the opening of a playback, the time spent negotiating with the server and the time the web client takes to create its video element.
When its source is lost (a failure during playback, or the page coming back from the background), Lumen reopens the film at the same position before handing over to the regular player.
On TVs and game consoles, playback stays with the regular player. Two quick skips in a row now add up while a seek is in progress.
Seeking inside what is already loaded no longer reloads it. The playback log records where the opening time goes.
iPhone and iPad: sound now plays when the device is in silent mode, as in any video app.
With "Play with Lumen" unchecked, files the server direct-plays are no longer played by Lumen. The first logged playback now appears in the log.
Maintenance release: code comments cleaned up, no change in behaviour.
